input.summary: Add Licensee affiliate/successor assignment carve-out with mutual reasonable-consent standard, and remove automatic termination on Licensee change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need to be able to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and a change of control of Licensee cannot automatically terminate the Agreement or our licenses — our playbook treats a blanket assignment bar and a change-of-control termination right as walk-away items. We have made the consent standard mutual and reasonable, and kept Licensor from assigning to a competitor of ours; if helpful, we can instead move to mutual assignment to successors on written notice.

ops.oldText: Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
ops.newText: Licensee may assign this Agreement and its rights hereunder, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. Otherwise, neither party may assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its rights hereunder in whole or in part without the other party's prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, delayed or conditioned; provided that Licensor shall not assign this Agreement to any competitor of Licensee.

ops.oldText: (a) Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor; provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent to the consummation of a Change of Control. For purposes of the preceding sentence, Licensor will be deemed to have reasonably withheld its consent to a Change of Control if any person or entity who would acquire direct or indirect control (as defined below) of Licensee pursuant to such Change of Control then conducts a business that is directly or indirectly competitive with a business then conducted by Licensor or any of its Affiliates and/or Licensor reasonably believes that Licensor's interests will be adversely effected by the continuing of this Agreement upon such a Change in Control.
ops.newText: (a) A Change of Control (as defined below) of Licensee shall not terminate this Agreement or any of Licensee's rights or licenses hereunder, and shall not give rise to any right of Licensor to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement; provided that Licensee shall give Licensor written notice of any Change of Control within thirty (30) days after its consummation.
